pdf.filename: 69_W.C. Moshier, G.D. Davis, J.S. Ahearn, H.F. Hough, J Electrochem Soc, 134 (1987) 2677-2684.pdf

alloy.preparation: RF magnetron co-sputter deposition from separate Al and Mo targets onto a 5-cm single-crystal silicon wafer; deposition rate 5 Å/s and pre-deposition vacuum 10⁻⁷ torr. Immediately after deposition began, Si was cooled near −196°C to limit heating and Mo-rich precipitation; deposited thickness 0.8–1.0 µm. Slowly warmed to ambient before removal. Center of wafer cleaved into eight sections to minimize composition/thickness gradients; scratched sections excluded. Test specimen masked with lacquer and dried for 24 h.
alloy.microstructure: Pure Al film, fcc structure with approximately 0.25-µm grains.

test_solution.preparation: Reagent-grade KCl mixed with 500 ml distilled water to 0.1 N; first degassed under vacuum, then deaerated with high-purity nitrogen. pH adjusted to 8 with KOH. Magnetic stirring vigorously agitated the solution throughout testing.

test_method.procedure_description: Immerse and monitor potential until equilibrium Ecorr, defined as <1 mV change in open-circuit potential over 6 min. PAR 273 potentiostat/galvanostat; platinum-mesh counter electrode at least ten times working-electrode area; SCE approximately 2 mm from surface through a Luggin probe. Anodic scan from Ecorr; no numerical electrolyte test temperature is supplied.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Eb determined from rapid current-density increase during anodic polarization, correlated with pits seen by HSEM. For Al–13Mo, no surface degradation after polarization to 0 V (SCE) is a lower bound, not a breakdown event.

experiments.result_note: Approximate discrete breakdown-potential reading, determined by rapid current-density increase during potentiodynamic polarization. The paper associates Eb with visible pit formation; the smooth fitted line is not an additional observation. Closely spaced concentrations are separate plotted specimens, not replicates inferred from the fit. Mo amount follows the Figure 6 mean-composition coordinate; Al is not calculated by difference. The −196°C substrate cooling and room-temperature storage characterization are not numerical test temperatures. No chloride-ion concentration is calculated from KCl normality.
